description: Analyze workflow, job, or step durations across recent runs to compare a specific CI run against recent history and surface slow spots.

branch.description: Optional: branch to compare against. When omitted, compares against runs from all branches.

conclusion.description: Optional: only include runs with a specific conclusion (success, failure, cancelled, etc.).

job_name.description: Optional: analyze a specific job across runs. Required when step_name is provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent runs to analyze (default: 10, max: 50).

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

run_id.description: Optional: focus on a specific workflow run ID. When omitted, the latest matching run is used.

step_name.description: Optional: analyze a specific step within job_name across runs.

workflow.description: Workflow selector (name, path, or numeric ID). Required unless run_id is provided.

name: analyze_timing

description: One-shot diagnosis of a failed workflow run: identifies failed jobs/steps, extracts error lines from logs, and optionally checks for flakiness. Returns a structured diagnosis with actionable error context.

check_flakiness.description: Compare against recent runs to detect flaky tests (default: true). Adds a few extra API calls.

max_error_lines.description: Total error-line budget across all jobs (default: 50, maximum: 200)

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

ref.description: Commit SHA, branch, or tag to diagnose when run_id is omitted; defaults to local HEAD for the configured repository.

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

run_id.description: The workflow run ID to diagnose. If omitted, selects a failed or active run on the exact ref/HEAD commit.

name: diagnose_failure

description: Download a workflow run artifact to disk

overwrite.description: Replace an existing destination atomically (default: false)

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

name: download_artifact

description: Get the contents of a workflow run artifact (stream without downloading to disk)

cursor.description: Opaque evidence continuation cursor; repeat the same selection arguments

file_pattern.description: Optional: glob pattern to filter files within the artifact (e.g., '*.txt', 'logs/*.log')

manifest_only.description: List file metadata without reading contents

max_bytes.description: Maximum content bytes per response after filtering (default 16384; metadata excluded)

max_file_size.description: Optional: maximum size of individual files to read in bytes (default: 1MB). Files larger than this will show size info only.

max_lines.description: Maximum content lines per response after filtering (default 100)

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

summary_only.description: Summarize recognized test reports without returning raw file contents

name: get_artifact

description: Get workflow status summary for a commit/branch/tag (derived from workflow runs; no Checks API permission required).

check_name.description: Optional: filter by specific check name

filter.description: Return latest workflow statuses (default) or all statuses for the ref. Allowed: latest, all.

format.description: Output format: summary (default), compact, or full

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

ref.description: Git ref (commit SHA, branch name, or tag) - default: HEAD of current branch

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

status.description: Optional: filter by status (queued, in_progress, completed)

name: get_check_status

description: Get workflow run details. Start with element=info, then use jobs/logs/log_sections/artifacts as needed.

artifact_id.description: For element=artifact_content: the artifact ID to get contents for

attempt_number.description: For element=jobs: attempt number for the jobs (default: latest)

context.description: For element=logs: number of lines to show before and after each search match (default: 0)

cursor.description: Opaque evidence continuation cursor; repeat the same selection arguments

element.description: Element to retrieve: info (default), jobs, logs, log_files, log_sections, artifacts, artifact_content. Invalid values return a validation error with allowed options.

file_pattern.description: For element=logs or artifact_content: glob pattern to filter files (e.g., '*.log', 'build/*')

format.description: For element=info, jobs, artifacts, log_files: output format (compact/full, default: compact)

head.description: For element=logs: select the first N lines before applying max_bytes/max_lines budgets

job_id.description: For element=logs or element=log_sections: specific job ID to get logs/sections for

max_bytes.description: Maximum content bytes per response after filtering (default 16384; metadata excluded)

max_file_size.description: For element=artifact_content: maximum size of individual files to read in bytes (default: 1MB)

max_lines.description: Maximum content lines per response after filtering (default 100)

no_headers.description: For element=logs: don't print file headers (=== filename ===)

offset.description: For element=logs: skip first N lines before returning (0-based)

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

per_job.description: For element=logs: get logs per-job instead of all logs combined

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

search.description: For element=logs: search/filter logs to lines containing this substring (case-insensitive)

search_regex.description: For element=logs: filter logs to lines matching this regex pattern

section.description: For element=logs: extract a specific section by name/pattern (e.g., 'Build', 'Test'). GitHub Actions sections are marked with ##[group]Section Name

tail.description: For element=logs: select the last N lines before applying max_bytes/max_lines budgets

name: get_run

description: List workflow runs with comprehensive filtering options

actor.description: Optional: GitHub username to filter by

branch.description: Optional: Branch to filter by. When omitted, runs from all branches are included.

conclusion.description: Optional: Conclusion to filter by (success, failure, neutral, cancelled, etc.)

created_after.description: Optional: ISO 8601 date string to filter runs created after this time

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous call

event.description: Optional: Event to filter by (push, pull_request, etc.)

format.description: Output format: minimal (basic fields), compact (default, most fields), or full (all fields)

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

status.description: Optional: Status to filter by (queued, in_progress, completed, etc.)

workflow_id.description: Optional: workflow ID, workflow name, or workflow file path (e.g., '12345678', 'CI', or '.github/workflows/ci.yml') to filter by

name: list_runs

description: List all workflows available in the repository

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous call

format.description: Output format: compact (default, single-line JSON), pretty (indented JSON), or full (detailed)

limit.description: Maximum number of workflows to return (default: 5)

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

name: list_workflows

description: Manage a workflow run (cancel, rerun, or rerun failed jobs)

action.description: Action to perform: cancel, rerun, or rerun_failed

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

run_id.description: The workflow run ID to manage

name: manage_run

description: Verify an immutable commit or run attempt, optionally diagnose failures, and return a resumable monitoring cursor. Without expected_workflows coverage is observed Actions workflows only, not required branch checks.

diagnose_on_failure.description: Include bounded failure evidence (up to two changed failed workflows).

expected_attempt.description: With run_id, wait for this exact rerun attempt.

expected_workflows.description: Workflow IDs or names expected on this commit. Missing workflows keep verification pending.

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

ref.description: Commit SHA, branch, or tag; defaults to local HEAD only for the configured repository.

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

run_id.description: Optional: monitor this run instead of a commit.

name: verify_commit

description: Wait silently for terminal run status and completion of every job across all pages, regardless of job conclusion.

expected_attempt.description: Expected run attempt, such as manage_run.expected_attempt after a rerun. A newer attempt is reported as superseded.

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

run_id.description: The workflow run ID to wait for

timeout_minutes.description: Maximum time to wait in minutes (default: 30)

name: wait_all

description: Resolve a ref to one immutable commit and wait for its discovered Actions workflows to complete. Does not cover third-party checks or prove all expected workflows registered; use verify_commit to name expected workflows.

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

ref.description: Git ref (commit SHA, branch name, or tag) - default: HEAD

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

timeout_minutes.description: Maximum time to wait in minutes (default: 30)

name: wait_for_commit_checks

description: Wait silently until the run completes or a job/step failure is observed. failure_observed does not mean the run has completed; use watch_run for bounded resumable monitoring.

expected_attempt.description: Expected run attempt, such as manage_run.expected_attempt after a rerun. A newer attempt is reported as superseded.

owner.description: Optional: override repository owner for this call

repo.description: Optional: override repository name for this call

run_id.description: The workflow run ID to wait for

timeout_minutes.description: Maximum time to wait in minutes (default: 30)

name: wait_for_run

description: Resume a pinned CI target using its signed cursor. Returns changed workflows/jobs only, completion evidence, and the next cursor. No remote mutations.

cursor.description: Cursor from verify_commit or watch_ci; expires after 24 hours.

name: watch_ci
